label: D1 after a rare a1->S2 transition, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1, the fixation step where the previous outcome is shown. 87.7% of activation mass comes when the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (prev_action==1 & prev_common==0). It almost never fires after an a2 choice or after a common transition. It is also strongly gated by time in the episode: essentially silent before trial 50, with rate rising steadily up to trials 90-99. It fires when the model value is low (<7.1), which matches a late-episode decline. Magnitude is largest when the rare a1->S2 trial was rewarded (the top activations are r1 after a1 S2R; prev_reward==1 gives precision 0.73 but covers only 44% of mass), though unrewarded rare trials also activate it. It never fires at GO or D2. All variables are observed at D1 (ep_trial is not a direct input; the agent must track elapsed time). Restricting to ep_trial>=70 gives the best F1 (0.64 dev); without the time gate recall is 0.87 but precision is only 0.19. Remaining false positives are late-episode rare-a1 D1 steps where it stays silent, so precision is incomplete.
